boundary.note: The local station host is reached through LocalTempTransport, the one seam in this package. Interactions are the messages that cross it: a provision request in, a pair of URLs back. test/local-station.contract.test.ts fakes exactly that seam and drives the real provisionTemporaryEnvironmentStation() against each recorded reply.
boundary.consumerNote: The Examples dev server implements this transport in site/scripts/vite-temporary-station-api.mts, handing back its own same-origin /api/anon/host/<id>/ URL. The recorded loopback replies are the shapes it produces.
